articles.title: Spot XRP ETFs attract biggest inflows since January
articles.snippet: The five U.S.-listed spot XRP funds pulled in $25.8 million on Monday, the largest single-day net inflow since Jan. 5, even as ether spot ETFs shed nearly $17 million.

articles.title: Elliptic raises $120 million backed by Nasdaq, Deutsche Bank as AI reshapes crypto security
articles.snippet: The crypto analytics firm plans to expand its AI-powered monitoring tools as stablecoins and tokenized finance grow rapidly, CEO Simone Maini said.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: SUI drops 4.9%, as index trades lower
articles.snippet: Bittensor (TAO), down 4.4% from Monday, joined Sui (SUI) as an underperformer.

articles.title: ETH/BTC ratio falls to 10-month low as ether continues to underperform bitcoin
articles.snippet: Widely followed crypto market gauge signals weakening risk appetite as investors continue favoring bitcoin over ether.

articles.title: Cathie Wood’s Ark Invest chases Circle stock as it hits a 2-month high
articles.snippet: Circle shares rose 16% to $131.76 on Monday, their highest closing price since March 18.
